prompt: Priya posted an alert about OOM kills hitting the cluster-b inference pods in one of our channels. For the incident postmortem, pull the member list — with each person's workspace role — for whichever workspace contains that channel.
binding_note: Route: user_teams (r0) -> teams (r1) via team_id; channels (r2) -> teams (r1) via team_id; messages (r3) -> channels (r2) via channel_id; messages (r3) -> users (r4) via user_id as message author. Priya (r4) authoring the cluster-b/OOM alert message (r3) pins the conversation (#core-infra, C_INFRA = r2) and, through its team_id, pins the workspace (T01WORKSPACE = r1). The deliverable r0 is the set of user_teams rows whose team_id equals that pinned workspace's team_id, each carrying its own role attribute. A similarly-themed OOM message authored by a different user in a different channel/workspace (Orbit Labs) must not pin that other team_id.

obligations.name: pinned_workspace_membership_roster
obligations.description: Select all user_teams rows whose team_id equals the team_id of the channel that contains the message where Priya reported the cluster-b/OOM alert; report each member's user and role.
obligations.scope: every user_teams row for the single workspace resolved via the fixed r0-r1-r2-r3-r4 chain

task_spec.text: Find the channel containing Priya's cluster-b/OOM memory-pressure alert message, determine which workspace it belongs to, and list that workspace's members together with their workspace roles.

access_plan: Use conversations.list/conversations.history (or search.messages with a query such as 'OOM cluster-b') to locate the alert message and confirm its author is Priya and its channel is core-infra; use conversations.info on that channel to obtain its team_id (T01WORKSPACE). Then call users.list scoped with team_id=T01WORKSPACE to enumerate the workspace's members and their roles, corresponding to the user_teams rows for that team_id.
